verdict.rationale: AskFred is a first-party AI assistant that answers natural-language questions about single meetings or across meetings, with conversational follow-ups that keep context. The official Fireflies MCP server (also reachable through ChatGPT via OAuth) lets users query their data and take actions in natural language, such as sharing meetings, moving them to channels, and creating soundbites. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language commands beyond Q&A (e.g., configuring bots, settings or recordings by command), a broader documented set of action tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
